ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass via ICMLuaUtil
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using ICMLuaUtil Elevated COM interface

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Processid\\:\\{3E5FC7F9\\-9A51\\-4367\\-9063\\-A120244FBEC7\\}.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Processid\\:\\{D2E7041B\\-2927\\-42FB\\-8E9F\\-7CE93B6DC937\\}.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "WerFault\.exe"))
